blocking_findings: REQ-020 and REQ-022 use a GitHub Check Run as a claim without an atomic durable first-side-effect conditional reservation keyed by exact release identity; duplicate deliveries or runs can both dispatch.
REQ-021 has no atomic reservation/commit ledger for append-only mutation receipt sequencing; Check Run creation is neither unique nor immutable.

residual_risks: Live Vault signer binding, broker egress identity, rulesets, runners, and network enforcement remain implementation gates.
Negative and fault suites are specified but remain to be executed during implementation.
The raw 697-byte handoff and 436-byte dispatch payloads are not separate fixture files and must be added for byte-level implementation validation.

blocking_findings: Live DeploymentGrant runner-config-dev already uses immutable profile arc-path-helm and permits only controller and scale-set components. Reusing that grant name with artifact-capability-path-helm is not deployable without an explicit migration or new-grant contract.
The current profile lacks the broker resource scopes for Service, NetworkPolicy, PDB, ServiceMonitor, PrometheusRule, and cert-manager resources.
Broker ingress is undefined for candidate and monitoring traffic, and the candidate runner control/log/action path to GitHub is undefined despite general egress denial.
Standard NetworkPolicy cannot enforce hostname-only OVH S3 and GitHub OIDC/JWKS broker egress without exact CIDRs or a centrally controlled egress proxy/gateway contract.
residual_risks: kata-clh-runtime-rs and the two new namespaces are absent and require ordered infrastructure work.
Vault transit signing policy, service-account JWT audience, internal CA distribution, and monitoring ingress need exact contracts.
TST-013 must machine-bind the accepted kubeconfig and context to codicarium-dev.

consensus.summary: Planner and QA returned GO, but security and DevOps found atomic coordination, recovery-authority, immutable DeploymentGrant migration, and enforceable network-path gaps. v1.9 cannot authorize implementation.
